tests.name: Health Sync OS permission keys in the deployed build: the vitana-app-version meta is the verified commit (when SHA is set); the de catalogue in the entry bundle and the locale-<code> chunks for ar, en, es, fr, pl, pt, ru, sr, tr, zh each contain screens.nativeHealthSync.osPermission.iosShareUsage and .privacyPolicyTitle, non-empty, with exactly the committed value. No sign-in; GETs of the document and static JS assets only; read-only

Catalogue shape: both keys in all 11 shards, non-empty, no _pending_review sibling, usage text names Apple Health, no locale copies de/en, German du-form (no Sie/Ihr/Ihnen) and no unhyphenated 22+ character word, no write-permission key
tests.reason: The staging spec proves the keys reached the deployed catalogues; the Vitest pins the register, compound-word and translation rules on the source shards, which the deployed bundle cannot show.
